contexts.text: Faith is the containant of the Knowledges of faith which are inseminated.
The things which man hears from the Word, and keeps in the memory, is nothing but insemination...

His ground is... in the intellectual part, in which truths are inseminated... (But) with the man of the Most Ancient Church, the ground was in the voluntary part, in which the Lord inseminated goods... How insemination in the voluntary part and in the intellectual part is circumstanced. Explained.
Seed will never cease to be inseminated in man by the Lord...
All good and truth must be inseminated in freedom. AC 1947:end.
Nor can truth be inseminated, except in the good which is from the Lord.
Such is the insemination and inrooting of faith...
In those (who are not in goods) there cannot be inseminated anything of Heaven...
Thus good is that in which truths are inseminated and implanted.
That thus will perish the truth which has been inseminated. Signified.
To sow the earth = when the truths and goods of faith are being inseminated.
When the ground has been thus prepared, then the truths of faith are inseminated... For the truths which are inseminated must be implanted in good...
How the truth of faith is inseminated and implanted in man, is known... but not well how the good of charity...
What is inseminated in freedom remains, because it is inrooted in the very will of the man... But what is inseminated in compulsion does not remain...
The Knowledges of the truths of faith... serve as for ground, in which can be inseminated the spiritual and celestial Truths of faith. Without such ground they cannot be easily inseminated...
